articles.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
articles.description: Trump criticized Big Oil for making “too much money,” but oil majors have since reported surging refining earnings as fuel supplies tightened.

articles.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
articles.description: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

articles.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
articles.description: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
articles.description: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

articles.title: Alaska Senate election: DOJ wants to 'segregate' all ballots for 2nd Sullivan candidate
articles.description: The winner of the Alaska election could determine whether Republicans retain their majority in the U.S. Senate or if Democrats take control of the chamber.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says it's time to look beyond tech. Here are 4 consumer stocks he likes
articles.description: Cramer said investors looking to diversify beyond the struggling AI trade should consider consumer staples.

articles.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns
articles.description: Meta has been given a negative outlook by S&P Global Ratings due to the company's hefty capital expenditures and concerns about free cash flow.

articles.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Expect more volatility as tech earnings, midterms loom
articles.description: Investors await earnings from Apple, AMD, and other major companies, as well as the midterm elections and the monthly jobs report.

articles.title: Gamble on democracy: Inside suspicious election-contracts trading on prediction markets
articles.description: CNBC examines unusual price spikes in election prediction markets and how low-volume contracts can be moved by relatively small trades.

articles.title: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen
articles.description: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.

articles.title: Fed officials are already saying they’ll need to get back to hiking rates
articles.description: The comments from Federal Reserve Presidents Alberto Musalem and Lorie Logan offer the first morsels of insight into what leaders at the Fed see happening next.

articles.title: Binance loses $6.3 billion in crypto heist—what happens to your money when an exchange gets hacked
articles.description: Crypto exchanges make it easier to buy, sell and store digital assets, but they come with risks, too.

articles.title: $6.3 billion Binance hack is largest crypto theft on record
articles.description: Binance says a security breach impacted about $6.3 billion in assets. The exchange says roughly $3 billion has been frozen and losses will be covered.

articles.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
articles.description: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

articles.title: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand
articles.description: Intel beat third-quarter earnings expectations, but warned of a prolonged PC slump, sending shares to their worst daily decline in 50 years.

articles.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
articles.description: Investors are nervous about the massive AI spending from the tech giants and whether that will pay off.

articles.title: Worried About Crypto Hacks? Buy Bitcoin Proxies in Stock Market Instead, Say Wall Street Firms
articles.description: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the record $6.4 billion theft is a Binance security failure, not a crypto-wide threat, pointing clients toward proxies like Coinbase, Robinhood, and Strategy.

articles.title: 'Bad time to troll': Binance co-founder Zhao asks Musk for support after hack
articles.description: Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao asked Elon Musk to stop “trolling” after a $6.3 billion hack, pointing to Binance’s $1 billion-plus SpaceX stake.

articles.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
articles.description: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

articles.title: Reddit Stock Plunges 30% as Google's AI Search Hits Traffic and User Growth
articles.description: Reddit shares are down 44% this week after CEO Steve Huffman warned that Google's AI-powered search features are cutting referrals, while weaker user growth and disappointing fourth-quarter guidance added to investor concerns.
